message: Hey John, can you give me an update on how my kid's day is going? Any thing else worth attention?
Reminder: Parent-teacher meetings are scheduled for next week. Please RSVP.
Little Steps Daycare will be closed this Friday for staff training.
Thanks for the photos from the art class, John! My kid looked so happy.
Flu season is here. Please ensure your child's vaccination records are up to date.
Is there anything special I need to bring for the cultural diversity day next week?
For cultural diversity day, we're asking parents to bring a traditional dish or story from their culture. It's going to be a fun learning experience for the kids!
I've updated the activity logs for this month. You'll be pleased to see your child's progress in language skills!
John, I'm concerned about the upcoming weather changes. Will outdoor activities be adjusted accordingly?
Absolutely, we always adjust our schedule to ensure the children's safety and comfort. Indoor activities are planned for days with extreme weather.
